sourceNotice: Derived from AIP Japan (AIRAC 1 Nov 2026), may not be current, edited by the Horus project and not government-made.

package.sourceKind: Official AIP Japan instrument RNAV SID/STAR charts from the SWIM AIP viewer, AIRAC 1 Nov 2026 issue (slice 3 plates).
package.headingNote: Coding tables publish both magnetic course and true course in parentheses, with magnetic variation -7.9 (RJTT) or -7.5 (RJAA) as printed. This extract keeps both values as printed. Horus headings are a geodetic/true frame; do not apply magnetic variation to simulator headings.
package.altitudeNotation: Bare altitude = AT (matches narrative 'at'). Prefix + = at or above. Prefix - = at or below. FLnnn is stored as a flight level, not converted to feet in this file.

uncertain.items: Page-footer effective dates versus the package AIRAC date
uncertain.reason: The PDFs were taken from the AIP Japan issue labelled AIRAC 1 Nov 2026. Footer dates record when that plate was last marked effective; they are older than the package date when the plate was not reissued.

uncertain.items: STAR E/T versus G/N versus a single runway
uncertain.reason: Chart headers are RNAV STAR RWY34L/34R (E/T) or RWY16R/16L (G/N). The extract does not map a suffix to a single runway.

crossCheck.method: For every TF leg whose both ends have published coordinates and a published distance and true course, spherical great-circle (radius 6371 km, 1 NM = 1852 m) is compared to the table. Pairs with distance difference > 0.05 NM or initial true-course difference > 0.05° are listed in flaggedPairs.
crossCheck.geometryRoundingNote: flaggedPairs use a 0.05 NM / 0.05° threshold on a sphere of radius 6371 km. All 16 flagged pairs in this extract differ by at most 0.073° / 0.069 NM. They are treated as spherical rounding versus the published table, not as parse errors. Coordinates and published courses were not altered.
